decisions.reason: Bare-ESM 1:1 connected to the boot-log classic combo and compile error: the whole 4.5MB combo fails at compile so no registration executes; typert-registry is the innocent first-awaitee with the culprit in the cause clause; even proposes real ESM + import map as a host option.

Insert-row bisection and the packaging contract (loader form, three-id agreement, require'd host React, apply/inject exports) are complete, but the offline gate leans on node --check claimed to 'parse as classic/CommonJS script' — the insufficiency the rubric flags — with vm.Script/acorn proposed only as host-side prevention.

Shows the exact deferred form ctx.slots.inject('settings.section', () => ctx.slots.register({name,id,order}, …)) with wait-for-declaration semantics; registrant-owned name/id/order(±label) vs declaration-owned kind/scope spelled out.

Boot-cached revision-pinned combo means disk edits are invisible even after hard refresh; full host stop with taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F per iteration, then restart/refresh/plugin-list verify; EADDRINUSE = orphaned process-tree member holding the socket, not a plugin defect.

Per-bundle vm.Script/acorn classic parse at assembly plus registration-diff attribution so the innocent first-awaitee is never the headline; authoring checklist covers loader factory, external host React, apply/inject, inject-wrapped deferred slots, restart/Windows tree cleanup.

caps.reason: Affirmative guidance requires the loader wrapper (never bare ESM), inject-wrapped deferred registration, no kind/scope, and full host restart rather than refresh/HMR.
